title: 按键持续时间最长的键
summary: 按顺序给出每次按键释放时刻与按键字符，求单次持续时间最长的键；并列时取字母较大者。
insight: 当前持续时间是当前释放时刻减上一次释放时刻。扫描并维护最大时长及对应字符，在更长或等长但字符更大时更新。
pitfalls: 第一次按键从时刻零开始
比较单次按键而非同字符总时长
并列选择字典序较大的字符

solutions.title: 相邻释放时刻差扫描
solutions.idea: 在线比较每次按键持续时间。
steps: 若更长或等长且字符更大则更新；previous=当前释放时刻

code.java: class Solution { public char slowestKey(int[] releaseTimes,String keysPressed){int previous=0,bestDuration=0;char answer='a';for(int i=0;i<releaseTimes.length;i++){int duration=releaseTimes[i]-previous;char key=keysPressed.charAt(i);if(duration>bestDuration||duration==bestDuration&&key>answer){bestDuration=duration;answer=key;}previous=releaseTimes[i];}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun slowestKey(releaseTimes:IntArray,keysPressed:String):Char{var previous=0;var bestDuration=0;var answer='a';for(i in releaseTimes.indices){val duration=releaseTimes[i]-previous;val key=keysPressed[i];if(duration>bestDuration||duration==bestDuration&&key>answer){bestDuration=duration;answer=key};previous=releaseTimes[i]};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: char slowestKey(vector<int>& releaseTimes,string keysPressed){int previous=0,bestDuration=0;char answer='a';for(int i=0;i<(int)releaseTimes.size();++i){int duration=releaseTimes[i]-previous;char key=keysPressed[i];if(duration>bestDuration||(duration==bestDuration&&key>answer)){bestDuration=duration;answer=key;}previous=releaseTimes[i];}return answer;} };
